author: Z.B. Steele
description:
A framed narrative is a story within a story. Typically, a narrator set in their present will tell tales from their past, usually with a heavy dose of foreshadowing or with the ending already clear.  Examples are numerous and long-standing, particularly in the fantasy realm.
